title: orchestrator.driver
description: Contract E1. Written by the engine at init; the daemon rewrites the session block before any re-spawn and the engine never edits it back. An absent block is equivalent to a terminal driver.

cwd.description: Absolute, because resume is directory-coupled on both providers. A moved or copied run directory is re-entered only by a new session.

session.description: The provider-side resumable handle. Both providers resume by name; one of them additionally by id.
